title: Soil bulk density from organic carbon and sampled depth
timing_contract: Same soil-sampling occasion; Corg, sampling depth and pH are measured covariates available before BD inference. This is a laboratory-measurement substitution task, not a future forecast.
calibration: No held-out country BD calibration; country identifiers are grouping metadata, never predictors.
independent_unit: Entire country/site portfolio, with all transects, fields and depths linked. Eight countries are convenience samples, not a random population sample.
scope_limits: Texture is unavailable in six countries and excluded rather than imputed. C stocks are excluded because they use bulk density algebraically.
Observational associations do not identify an agroforestry treatment effect. Protocol adaptations and country effects may limit transfer.
exposure: Two Finland rows were seen during schema inspection, so Finland is development-only. Reserved countries were allocated by metadata-only hash before target inspection. All outputs are exposed after this campaign.
uncertainty_policy: Country-balanced errors and explicit individual-country results; two confirmation countries are insufficient for precise population confidence.
selection_rule: Lowest mean group development MAE among all controls and attempts; within 0.5% choose fewer parameters. Selection and continuation use development only.
continuation_rule: At least five substantive attempts; stop after two consecutive attempts without supported predictive, worst-group, or interpretive gain.
